correctness.rationale: The stated generator g(x)=2+x^2+2x^3+x^4+x^5 has degree five and unique six-symbol ternary messages, so exactly 3^6=729 distinct length-11 codewords without modular wraparound. Fresh direct polynomial multiplication and all eleven cyclic length-b windows for each of the 729 messages give b=2 weights (7:44,8:88,9:110,10:220,11:266), b=3 (8:22,9:44,10:132,11:530), b=4 (9:22,10:44,11:662), b=5 (10:22,11:706), plus the zero word in each case. All b>=6 nonzero words have weight11, agreeing with stabilizing run theory. The b=1 distribution (5:132,6:132,8:330,9:110,11:24) matches the known Hamming enumerator. Each tally sums to729. This is a complete exact finite census for the FIXED cyclic coordinate order, not an infinite extrapolation.
